raw_text: The Indian Army has placed its units along the Myanmar border in Mizoram on heightened alert following airstrikes by Myanmar's military junta in Chin State barely five kilometres from Indian territory. District officials in Champhai confirmed that explosions were audible from the Indian side early Wednesday morning. The Mizoram government has activated relief camps as fresh batches of refugees from Chin State begin crossing the border. The Ministry of External Affairs has taken note of the situation.
clean_text: Indian Army on heightened alert along Myanmar border after Chin State airstrikes 5km from Indian territory. Mizoram activating relief camps for incoming refugees.
